items.title: Walmart (WMT) Faces Child Labor Settlement As Valuation Questions Return
items.summary: Walmart (WMT) is back in focus after agreeing to a record US$7.8 million child labor settlement in Pennsylvania, raising fresh questions for investors about compliance risk and long term oversight. Despite the regulatory headlines, Walmart’s recent price action has stayed resilient. At a share price of US$126.19, the stock has a 30 day share price return of 12.39% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 24.1%.
